description: US foreclosure listings for a city or ZIP (from Foreclosure.com; RealtyTrac's public site has been offline since October 2026): per home the listing type, estimated market value, street, city, state, ZIP, property type, beds, baths, living area, estimated rent, auction date when there is one, photo count, main photo and link, 10 per page, plus how many listings the place has of each type (foreclosures, HUD, pre-foreclosures, sheriff sales, bankruptcy, tax liens, short sales, city owned, auctions). Filter by status. Related tools on this server, for a different need: realestate_immowelt when you need German property listings from immowelt.de for a city: per; realestate_loopnet when you need LoopNet commercial real estate listings for a US city. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

city.description: City name, e.g. atlanta or 'el paso' (give city+state, or add zip)

page.description: Page number from 1 (default 1), 10 listings per page

status.description: all (default), foreclosure, bank-owned, auction, pre-foreclosure, sheriff-sale, tax-lien, short-sale, bankruptcy, hud, city-owned

zip.description: Optional 5-digit ZIP inside the city (needs city+state), e.g. 30331

name: realestate_realtytrac
title: US foreclosure listings for a city or ZIP: per home
